Language Movement veteran Akmat Ali dies
2018-09-14T00:00:00+06:00 | Our Correspondent, Tangail
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/news/language-movement-veteran-akmat-ali-dies-1633708

Language Movement veteran Akamot Ali Talukder died yesterday at a hospital in Dhaka, a press release said. He was 90.

A retired teacher of Bhuapur Pilot High School, Akmot Ali was suffering from old age complications.

He left behind his wife, three sons and four daughters to mourn his death.

He was buried at his family graveyard in Ghatail upazila with state-honour following a namaz-e-janaza.

Akamot Ali took part in the 1952 Language Movement, when he was a student of Dhaka University.
